title: Matrix Most Wanted: Power Architecture Watchlist
subtitle: The 10 public-record accountability targets closest to the rails of AI, data, cloud, finance, satellites, defence and platform control
mission: Track the people most capable of shaping the modern surveillance-control architecture through public-record power: compute, cloud, AI models, social data, defence analytics, identity/payment rails, healthcare/government data, satellites, finance and political access.
boundary: This is not a criminal wanted list and not a declaration of guilt. It is an accountability watchlist. Inclusion means the person sits near high-power infrastructure that deserves public-record scrutiny. Claims must be separated into confirmed, alleged, open, missing and not-proven lanes.
scoringModel: ability to acquire, censor, rank, model or route information

targets.name: Elon Musk
targets.role: SpaceX / Starlink / Tesla / xAI / X / Neuralink
targets.watchGrade: A for public power rails; C for agenda/intent claims
targets.whyRanked: Musk combines unmatched private space-launch capacity, Starlink communications reach, Tesla mobility/software data, X information distribution, xAI model development and direct political influence. This places him at the top of the power-architecture list.
targets.confirmed: Public-record power lanes include SpaceX/Starlink, Tesla, X, xAI and Neuralink; current wealth rankings place him at or near the top globally.
targets.notProven: This card does not prove a criminal agenda, trafficking involvement or hidden control plan.
targets.missingRecords: Government contract map, Starlink military/government use cases, X data/government request policy, xAI government contracts, Neuralink regulatory filings.
targets.nextPull: Create Musk dossier with contracts, platform-policy records, lobbying/political finance and public statements.

targets.name: Larry Ellison
targets.role: Oracle co-founder / CTO / Stargate AI infrastructure / Oracle Health
targets.watchGrade: A for infrastructure role; C for agenda/intent claims
targets.whyRanked: Ellison sits on a rare convergence: Oracle database infrastructure, government cloud, health-record systems through Oracle Health/Cerner, and the Stargate AI infrastructure lane with OpenAI and SoftBank.
targets.confirmed: Oracle is a central enterprise/government data company; Stargate publicly links Oracle with OpenAI and SoftBank in a proposed AI infrastructure buildout.
targets.notProven: This card does not prove surveillance misuse or criminal wrongdoing.
targets.missingRecords: Oracle government cloud contracts, Oracle Health public-sector records, Stargate governance documents, TikTok/Project Texas data-control records where applicable.
targets.nextPull: Create Oracle/Ellison dossier with government-cloud, health-data and AI-infrastructure records.

targets.name: Sam Altman
targets.role: OpenAI CEO / Stargate operational AI lane
targets.watchGrade: A for frontier AI influence; C for agenda/intent claims
targets.whyRanked: Altman leads one of the most influential frontier-AI organizations, drives agentic AI deployment, and is linked to the Stargate infrastructure buildout. The power concern is not just chatbots; it is decision automation, model access and public/private AI adoption.
targets.confirmed: OpenAI is a leading frontier AI lab; public reports and announcements link OpenAI to Stargate and government AI work.
targets.notProven: This card does not prove malicious intent or unlawful surveillance use.
targets.missingRecords: Government contracts, model deployment policies, public-sector use agreements, safety governance, data-retention and enterprise access policies.
targets.nextPull: Create OpenAI/Altman dossier with government contracts, Stargate records and policy statements.

targets.name: Jensen Huang
targets.watchGrade: A for compute chokepoint; C for agenda/intent claims
targets.whyRanked: Huang controls the company that became the foundational hardware layer for modern AI. Whoever controls compute supply influences which governments, labs and corporations can scale models and automated decision systems.
targets.confirmed: NVIDIA became a central supplier of AI data-center hardware and one of the world's most valuable companies during the AI boom.
targets.notProven: This card does not prove wrongdoing or political agenda.
targets.missingRecords: Defence/customer segmentation, export-control records, government supply deals, Stargate supply links and robotics/edge AI deployment records.
targets.nextPull: Create NVIDIA/Huang dossier focused on compute chokepoints, export controls and government AI supply chain.

targets.name: Satya Nadella
targets.watchGrade: A for cloud/AI/platform reach; C for agenda/intent claims
targets.whyRanked: Nadella controls a platform stack that spans operating systems, cloud, office identity, enterprise security, developer infrastructure, LinkedIn and AI partnerships. That makes Microsoft one of the largest pipes for public/private digital governance.
targets.confirmed: Microsoft controls major enterprise, developer, cloud and AI infrastructure and maintains deep OpenAI and government-cloud lanes.
targets.notProven: This card does not prove a criminal agenda or unlawful surveillance.
targets.missingRecords: Azure government cloud contracts, OpenAI partnership records, GitHub policy/government request records, LinkedIn data and AI-use disclosures.
targets.nextPull: Create Microsoft/Nadella dossier with Azure, OpenAI, LinkedIn, GitHub and government-cloud records.

targets.name: Sundar Pichai
targets.watchGrade: A for search/mobile/video/cloud/AI reach; C for agenda/intent claims
targets.whyRanked: Pichai controls search, mobile OS, video distribution, ad infrastructure, cloud and AI. The power issue is ranking reality: what is surfaced, buried, monetized, modeled and automated.
targets.confirmed: Alphabet/Google controls major global search, YouTube, Android, advertising and cloud/AI infrastructure.
targets.notProven: This card does not prove intentional censorship or illegal surveillance.
targets.missingRecords: Search/ranking transparency, government requests, cloud defence contracts, AI model policy and location-data disclosures.
targets.nextPull: Create Alphabet/Pichai dossier with search, Android, YouTube, Gemini, Google Cloud and government request records.

targets.name: Mark Zuckerberg
targets.watchGrade: A for social graph/AI/wearables reach; C for agenda/intent claims
targets.whyRanked: Zuckerberg controls one of the largest social graphs, messaging ecosystems and ad-profile machines on earth, while pushing AI assistants and wearable camera/AR systems. This makes Meta a core social-surveillance accountability lane.
targets.confirmed: Meta operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger and Threads and is investing heavily in AI and wearable interfaces.
targets.notProven: This card does not prove illegal surveillance or trafficking involvement.
targets.missingRecords: Government request data, ad-targeting and fraud-control records, wearable privacy disclosures, AI data-use policies and content-ranking transparency.
targets.nextPull: Create Meta/Zuckerberg dossier with social graph, AI, ad systems, wearables and government request records.

targets.name: Jeff Bezos
targets.role: Amazon founder / executive chair / AWS / Blue Origin / media ownership
targets.watchGrade: A for cloud/logistics/space/media reach; C for agenda/intent claims
targets.whyRanked: Bezos combines AWS cloud infrastructure, commerce/logistics data, home-device ecosystems, space ambitions and media ownership. AWS is especially important because it underpins parts of government, enterprise and AI infrastructure.
targets.confirmed: Amazon/AWS is one of the dominant cloud providers; Bezos remains founder and executive chair with major wealth and influence.
targets.notProven: This card does not prove unlawful surveillance or criminal agenda.
targets.missingRecords: AWS government/intelligence contracts, Ring law-enforcement access policies, Blue Origin government contracts, data retention and platform policy records.
targets.nextPull: Create Amazon/Bezos dossier with AWS, Ring, Blue Origin, media and government-cloud records.

targets.name: Alex Karp
targets.watchGrade: A for defence/government data platform role; C for broader agenda claims
targets.whyRanked: Karp runs Palantir, one of the clearest public-record companies at the intersection of defence, intelligence, law enforcement, immigration data and AI-enabled decision systems.
targets.confirmed: Palantir has major government and defence lanes, including public reporting on Maven and immigration/law-enforcement data systems.
targets.notProven: This card does not prove unlawful use by itself; client use, legal basis and safeguards require record-level analysis.
targets.missingRecords: Contract maps, agency use cases, privacy impact assessments, audit records, civil-liberties assessments and public-response cards.
targets.nextPull: Create Palantir/Karp dossier with contracts, Maven, ICE/immigration systems and privacy-impact records.
sources: public reporting on Maven and ICE systems

targets.name: Larry Fink
targets.watchGrade: A for financial/risk-system reach; C for agenda/intent claims
targets.whyRanked: Fink controls the world's largest asset manager and one of the largest financial risk platforms. Even without direct surveillance powers, capital allocation can decide which AI, data-center, energy, defence and digital-identity systems scale.
targets.confirmed: BlackRock is the world's largest asset manager and operates the Aladdin risk-management platform used across large pools of assets.
targets.notProven: This card does not prove hidden control, criminal conduct or a personal surveillance agenda.
targets.missingRecords: Aladdin client scope, data-center/AI infrastructure exposure, proxy-voting records, digital identity/payment investments and public policy statements.
targets.nextPull: Create BlackRock/Fink dossier with AUM, Aladdin, infrastructure financing and governance records.
